api.clock: required trusted host Callable[[], int], Unix seconds
api.ticket_expiry: deadline for initial activation completion; not lifetime of an already-active session
sample_points: after worker scheduling, before provider call
api.expired_recovery: local terminal revoke with durable lookup/known-session cleanup; never new activation

storage.old_binary_fencing: on reopening only; stop all already-running v2 processes
storage.migration: explicit offline v2-to-v3 with required new bounded post-upgrade recovery allowances; no reset on v3

deadlines.cleanup_budget: one monotonic budget across the batch and nested provider work

result_custody.historical_active_session: not expired solely by ticket TTL

not_provided: authenticated ingress and live identity/session revocation
encrypted metadata and bounded service deployment
claim_ceiling: Local source and regression behavior, not full HG-0087 closure, physical-device or production qualification.

recovery_budget.selection: non-exhausted pending jobs, least reservations used then job ID
recovery_budget.exhausted_work: retained pending; explicit operator escalation, no new activation
recovery_budget.pre_v3_history: uncounted; migration reports unknown historical usage and new allowance
